run_visEFT_singleSubject: run visEFT_singleSubject to visualize SMPL body mesh fitting results for a single person from pickle files
run_visEFT_multiSubjects: run visEFT_multiSubjects to visualize SMPL body mesh fitting results for multiple people in the same image
run_cli_visualize: run the script with --img_dir and --fit_dir arguments to visualize EFT fitting outputs interactively
run_render_to_files: run the script with --bRenderToFiles flag to export rendered SMPL mesh visualizations as image files
run_save_mesh_obj: run save_mesh_obj to export 3D mesh vertices and faces to a Wavefront OBJ file
